name: Plot Twist

description.content: While injured, crouched and idle, use <Activate Ability> to be downed silently.
While downed this way, once per trial:

items: You make no Grunts of Pain.
You leave no Pools of Blood.

description.content: When all Generators are completed, you can use this ability again.

quote: "I think you'll find this shooting location... captivating." -Pauline Stamper
